benchmarks.label: legacy-alex-mercer-portfolio
benchmarks.prompt_summary: Build a creative developer profile site with hero band, skills section, project showcase, experience, and contact CTA.
benchmarks.notes: Decent portfolio reference. Key traits: strong hero atmosphere, clean typography pairing, polished dark portfolio framing, and a usable project/skills rhythm, but it should stay below the stronger portfolio benchmarks.

benchmarks.label: legacy-alex-mercer-neon-portfolio
benchmarks.prompt_summary: Build a modern software engineer portfolio with punchy hero copy, skill highlights, project cards, experience timeline, and strong call-to-action sections.
benchmarks.notes: Okay portfolio reference. Key traits: punchier uppercase hero treatment, neon-lime accent contrast, animated stat chips and skill bars, and a more assertive dev-brand tone, but it should remain below the stronger portfolio benchmarks.

benchmarks.label: legacy-apex-badass-site
benchmarks.notes: Legacy strong result for the vague prompt 'bbuild me a badass site'. Use as a local reference build when Discovery is unavailable or empty.

benchmarks.label: legacy-pysimple-cli-saas
benchmarks.prompt_summary: Build a premium SaaS/dev-tool landing page for a simple Python CLI tool with install tabs, code examples, API reference, integrations, pricing, and polished copy-to-clipboard interactions.
benchmarks.notes: Strong SaaS/dev-tool reference. Key traits: polished install-tab interaction, premium code-block presentation, docs-product hybrid structure, clean command-copy UX, and a restrained dark technical aesthetic that still feels premium.

benchmarks.label: legacy-pokemon-starters-fan-page
benchmarks.prompt_summary: can you build me a pokemon fan page website with charmander, bulbasaur, and squirtle characters? make the site look modern with pokemon graphics and design.
benchmarks.notes: Strong legacy Pokemon fan page. Key reference traits: click-triggered card animations, premium-feeling transitions, and type-colored glow halos behind each starter card.

benchmarks.label: legacy-digimon-agumon-fan-page
benchmarks.prompt_summary: build a Digimon fan page centered on Agumon with modern graphics, evolution showcase, and community sections.
benchmarks.notes: Strong Digimon fan page reference. Notable traits: oversized hero typography, warm orange glow system, animated mascot presentation, and a premium evolution timeline that makes the page feel like an interactive franchise tribute.

benchmarks.label: legacy-ff7-avalanche-archive
benchmarks.prompt_summary: create me a final fantasy 7 fan page website with cloud and barret and tifa characters. use generated ai images to make it look as close to the characters as possible. also showcase some weapons and a game map. have midgar in the background kind of transparent/blurred. make the website look very aesthetic
benchmarks.notes: Strong seeded FF7 fan-page reference. Key traits: cinematic worldbuilding hero, premium character cards with layered depth, atmospheric blurred-environment treatment, count-up hero stats, smooth-radius cards, polished iconography, and polished section transitions that make the page feel collector-edition rather than generic fandom content.

benchmarks.label: legacy-ff7-midgar-archives
benchmarks.prompt_summary: Create me a Final Fantasy 7 theme fan page site. Include characters like cloud, barrett, and tifa. Include a section for weapons and a map that shows the game map
benchmarks.notes: Strong seeded FF7 archive reference. Key traits: interactive browsing density, archive-style card system, and franchise-specific navigation states that make the fan page feel explorable rather than static.

benchmarks.label: legacy-ff7-legends-of-midgar
benchmarks.prompt_summary: Build a premium Final Fantasy VII fan page with Cloud, Tifa, and Barret, cinematic Midgar atmosphere, glowing cards, weapons, world map, and animated lore interactions.
prompt_hints: premium final fantasy vii fan page
benchmarks.notes: Strong FF7 cinematic fan-page reference. Key traits: premium gold-accent editorial typography, color-coded glow halos behind character cards, count-up hero stats, polished modal reveals with animated stat bars, and a high-end collector-edition feel.

benchmarks.label: legacy-ff9-zidane-vivi-tribute
benchmarks.prompt_summary: Build a premium Final Fantasy IX fan tribute for Zidane Tribal and Vivi Ornitier with cinematic hero art, character biography, animated skill bars, gallery interactions, and polished modal media viewing.
benchmarks.notes: Strong FF9 tribute reference. Key traits: polished editorial hero composition, premium modal media viewing, animated stat and skill-bar fills, differentiated character glow systems, and a refined fantasy-tech aesthetic that still feels modern.

benchmarks.label: legacy-precision-calculator-ui
benchmarks.prompt_summary: Build a premium precision calculator app with cinematic launch screen, responsive keypad interactions, HUD stats, animated history panel, and polished error/toast feedback.
benchmarks.notes: Global interaction benchmark. Key traits: cinematic entry transition, tactile button press feedback, polished HUD/status treatment, animated side-panel reveal, premium error/toast states, and a strong sense of motion without feeling gimmicky.

benchmarks.label: legacy-alpha-launch-wizard
benchmarks.prompt_summary: Build a premium multi-step launch wizard for a Python application with typed confirmation, animated validation logs, progress feedback, and polished success/error execution states.
benchmarks.notes: Global interaction benchmark. Key traits: premium multi-step progression, typed confirmation gating, animated validating log sequence, convincing run-state simulation, and polished success/error transitions that make a utility flow feel alive.
